embeds.title: WELCOME TO OATH FORSAKEN
embeds.description:
⛧ Oath Forsaken is an ironman-centric clan for scapers who love the grind. We PvM together, we skill together, and we hang out.

⛧ Ironmen get the full experience: Total Level Ranks, bingos, and WOM competitions.

⛧ Mains are welcome too. Earn seniority, join casual events, be part of the clan.

⛧ Just visiting? Come say hi as a guest.

⛧ Pick the application below that fits you and we'll get you sorted.

embeds.title: 📝 Clan Application
embeds.description:
To join **Oath Forsaken**, pick the application that fits you.

<:ironsworn:1558623401302564996> **Ironman** — you play an ironman and want full clan membership (Total Level Ranks, bingos, WOM competitions).

<:unbound:1558623453438025828> **Main** — you play a main; you can hang out, earn seniority, and join casual events.

<:guest:1558634092185002035> **Guest** — you're just visiting or here for a friend.
